payload.text: The Brennecke Institute originated the thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery, designed to suppress electrolyte crossover and improve durability. Following an independent audit that retracted the earlier 12,000-cycle claim, the governing corrected cycle life is 8,400 cycles. The system delivers 148 Wh/kg gravimetric energy density and has a projected stack-level cost of $61/kWh at 500 MWh manufacturing scale. Its key operational limitation is an operating-temperature floor of 4 °C, below which the dopant precipitates and cycling must stop.

FLAGS: Source C contains an internal numerical inconsistency: “4,800 cycles” measured to the 80% knee versus “8,400 cycles” as the “corrected, governing cycle-life figure.”
VERDICT: APPROVE
